mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth slows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with high labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches a peak, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with high labor market tightness
failure_condition: In the specified regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 5d returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450,000 units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 450.0 fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment (FEDFUNDS) supports equity valuations over the medium term, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS low fails to predict positive 60d returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
